quote: We further propose LayoutReader, a novel reading order detection model in which the seq2seq model is used by encoding the text and layout information and generating the index sequence in the reading order.
Reading order detection, aiming to capture the word sequence which can be naturally comprehended by human readers, is a fundamental task for visually-rich document understanding.
outputs: The model generates a sequence of word indices in reading order from document images, given tokens with their bounding boxes.

quote: We report Average Page-level BLEU in our experiments. The ARD score is proposed to evaluate the difference between reordered sequences.

We report Average Page-level BLEU ... The ARD score is proposed to evaluate the difference between reordered sequences ... The results show that LayoutReader is superior ... It improves the average pagelevel BLEU by 0.2847 and decreases the ARD by 6.71.

We report Average Page-level BLEU in our experiments. The page-level BLEU refers to the micro-average precision of n-gram overlaps within a page. The ARD score is proposed to evaluate the difference between reordered sequences.

Since the ReadingBank is generated in an automated manner, we further conduct human evaluation to study the dataset quality. We sample 20 pages from the ReadingBank and compare them with the human annotations. The average pagelevel BLEU score is 0.9839 and the ARD score is 0.4473, which indicates that the ReadingBank is highly consistent with the human annotations.
